s: puM, tIrTaviSezaH । yaTA, -- DaraRyuvAca । “dvArakAtaH paraM SrezWaM asti guhmaM paraM kvacit tato mahIvacaH SrutvA vizRuH kamalalocanaH । vArAharUpI BagavAn pratyuvAca vasunDarAm ॥ varAha uvAca । sAnandUreti viKyAtaM BUme ! guhyaM paraM mama । uttare tu samudrasya malayasya ca dakziRe । tatra tizWAmi vasuDe udIcIdiSamASritaH ॥ pratimA vE madIyAsti nAtyuccA nAtinIcakA । AyasIM tAM vadantyeke anyetAmrasayIM taTA ॥ kAMsyIM rItimayImanye kevit sIsakanirmitAm SilAmayImityapare mahadAScaryyarUpiRIm । tatra sTAnAni me BUme kaTyamAnaM mayA SfRu ॥ manujA yatra mucyante gatAH saMsArasAgaram । tatrAScaryyaM pravakzyAmi sAnandUre yaSasvini ! ॥ sOvarRaM dfSyate padmaM maDyAhne tu divAkare । yatra rAmagfhaM nAma mama guhyaM yaSasvini ॥ tatrApi SfRu cAScaryyaM yaccApi parivarttate । evaM tatra latA vfkzamuccasTUlamahAdrumam । samudramaDye tizWantaM so'pi tatra na paSyati ॥ * ॥ anyacca te pravakzyAmi mahAScaryyaM SfRuzva me । mama BaktAMSca paSyanti tizWanto hi svakarmmaRA ॥ bahumatsyasahasrARi kowyo hyarvvudameva ca । kziptaH piRqaSca tanmaDye yena kena vikarmmiRA ॥ ekastatra sTUlamatsyo BUmicakreRa cANkitaH । tAvat kaScinna gfhRAti yAvattena na BakzitaH ॥ tatra rAmasaraM nAma tasmin kzetre paraM mama । agADaYcApyapAraYca raktapadmaviBUzitam ॥ tatra snAnantu kurvvIta ekarAtrozito naraH । buDasya BavanaM gatvA modate nAtra saMSayaH ॥ aTa prARAn pramucyeta ramye rAmasare taTA । buDasya BavanaM tyaktvA mama lokaYca gacCati ॥ tatra rAmasare BUme mahAScaryyaM SfRuzva me । manujAstatra paSyanti mama karmmaparAyaRAH ॥ satsaraH kroSavistAraM bahugulmalatAkulam । manojYaM ramaRIyaYca jalajEScApi saMvftam ॥ tatra mUQAlipadmAni dyotayanti diSo daSa । ekantu dfSyate SvetamekaM rukmamayaM taTA ॥ tatra brahmasaraM nAma guhyaM kzetre paraM mama । uttareRa tu pArSvena mama kzetrasya sundari ॥ tatra kuRqaM mahABAge parvvate ca samASritam । DArA yatra pateccEva sTUlA muzalasanniBA ॥ tatra snAnaYca kurvvIta zazWakAlozito naraH । brahmalokaM samAsAdya modate nAtra saMSayaH ॥ aTa prARAn pramucyeta tatra brahmasare mama । brahmaRA samanujYAto mama lokaYca gacCati ॥ tatrAScaryyaM mahABAge ramye brahmasare SfRu । madBaktA yAni paSyanti GoraM saMsAramokzaRam ॥ caturvviMSatidvAdaSyAM sA DArA pfTalekzaRe । maDyAhne patate BUme yAvat sUryyaH sa tizWati ॥ parAvftte tu maDyAhne sA DArA na patedBuvi । evaM tatra mahAScaryyaM puRye brahmasare mama ॥” iti vArAhe sAnandUramAhAtmyanAmADyAyaH ॥
v: pu॰ tIrTaviSeze “sAnandUreti viKyAtaM BUme! guhyaM paraM mama । uttare tu samudrasya malayasya ca dakziRe । tatra tizWABi vasuDe! udIcIM diSamASritaH । pratimA vE madIyAsti nAtyuccA nAtinIcakA । AyasIM tAM vadantyeke anye tAmramayIM taTA । kAsyAM rotimayImanye kecit sIsakanirmitAm । SilAmayImityapare mahAScaryyasvarUpiRIm” varAhapu॰ ।

m: सान्त्व् (also written शान्त्व्, q.v.) cl. 10. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxxii, 33; rather Nom. fr. सान्त्व below) सान्त्वयति, ˚ते (pr. p. once in MBh. [viii, 243] सान्त्वमान and once [vi, 4910] सान्त्वयान; aor. अससान्त्वत् Gr.; ind.p. सान्त्वयित्वा, MBh.; सान्त्वय्य, BhP. : Pass. सान्त्व्यते, MBh.; Hariv.), to console, comfort, soothe, conciliate, address kindly or gently, Mn.; MBh. &c.

a: सानु — m., n. 1 A peak, summit, ridge; सानूनि गंधः सुरभीकरोति Ku. 1. 9; Me. 2; Ku. 1. 5; Ki. 5. 36. --2 A level ground on the top of a mountain, table-land. --3 A shoot, sprout. --4 A forest, wood. --5 A road. --6 Any surface, point, end. --7 A precipice. --8 A gale of wind. --9 A learned man. --10 The sun.
